items.title: Night premium for weekend shifts
items.description: Night shift hours worked on a Saturday or Sunday must earn a differential of 15 percent of the base rate. The weekend night differential must replace, not add to, the standard night differential.

items.title: Payslip correction window
items.description: Payroll corrections must be issued within 5 working days of an error being reported. Corrections must reference the original payslip.
